errors.text_span: като 2012 и 2013 са разположени като съседни категории
errors.evidence: The use of the term "категории" (categories) is imprecise for a time-series plot where the x-axis represents continuous time. While the data points are discrete, they are not categories in the typical sense used for bar charts.
The data point for 2013 in chart B is visibly above the 0.75% mark (the midpoint between 0.5 and 1.0). A more accurate approximation would be 0.8%.
The data point for 2021 in chart B is visibly lower than 2.3%. It is approximately at 2.2%. The description significantly overestimates the final value.
